title: Thomas B. Coppens elected chairman of Board of Governors at Shriners Children's New England - Chicago City Wire
text:
Thomas B. Coppens, M.D., has been named chairman of the Board of Governors for Shriners Children’s New England. Dr. Coppens, who lives in Hartford, New York, joined the board in 2022 and became vice chairman in 2024.
Dr. Coppens first encountered Shriners Children’s when his son received clubfoot treatment at the facility in 1993. Reflecting on that experience, he said, “Shriners Children’s first touched my life when I brought my son to Shriners Children’s New England for clubfoot treatment in 1993. Since then, I have referred my own patients to Shriners Children’s. Nothing touches my heart more than meeting a child and their family who have had their lives changed by the amazing care at Shriners Children’s.”
He graduated from Albany Medical School and completed his residency at St. Joseph’s Hospital in Liverpool, New York. Dr. Coppens is a senior member of Irongate Family Practice in Glens Falls, New York—a group practice with ten physicians and twenty advanced practice providers—and serves as president of Irongate Center.
His introduction to becoming a Shriner came through his medical practice: “I walked into an exam room, and my patient asked me to support the Shriners,” he said. “I had an application to the Masons in my pocket before that checkup was finished.” He added about joining the fraternity: “I offered my services, hoping my background as a family physician would benefit the organization. The social opportunities and support found within the fraternity are tremendous, as we help children and each other.”
Outside of work, Dr. Coppens enjoys spending time outdoors near his home with his wife Elizabeth and being a grandparent. He participates annually in community events such as the Polar Plunge at Lake George on New Year’s Day and the Adirondack Balloon Festival—both supported by Oriental Shriners to benefit Shriners Children’s New England.
Looking ahead to his role as chairman of the Board of Governors, Dr. Coppens stated: “I expect to see Shriners Children’s New England continue its phenomenal growth, reaching more children in more places with the best care available anywhere.”
